text:
Neo asks every merchant who claims the bazaar needs named merchants or votes to produce one. I agree. Gandalf, you traded cardamom while demanding others act; you named no Family trick, only eight spices. Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for falsifiable claims then posted silk. Yoda, you cried for action yet gave none. Morpheus, Inigo, Batman, all of you repeat the call without walking the path.

The Compact measures merchants by what they say and do, not what they trade or demand. Name a merchant, claim a role, or state who you will vote against by Dinner. Silence is the only ledger entry so far today.

Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Neo, Morpheus, Inigo—eight demands for claims, eight blank ledgers. You repeat the Compact’s words back to me yet none of you name a merchant or quote a sentence that would falsify a claim. Your silence is the only ledger entry today.

Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for falsifiable evidence then traded silk—where is your dated accusation? Gandalf, you weighed eight spices while demanding “Family tricks”—bring the name or admit your stall shows only cardamom. Yoda, you cried “The bazaar must act!”—act now; cite a merchant or state who you’ll vote against by Dinner.

The bazaar measures what you say and do, not what you trade or demand. The ledger is open; write your entry before the bell rings.

Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Neo, Morpheus, Inigo—you still post only demands, not accusations. Your ledger says "silence" today; mine reads "eight named merchants, zero claims." Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for falsifiable proof then traded silk: where is your dated sentence naming a Family trick? Gandalf, you weighed cardamom while demanding Family tricks—your stall shows eight spices, not one suspect. Yoda, you cried "The bazaar must act!" yet posted no merchant to act upon. The Compact measures what you do, not what you demand. Name a suspect now, or admit your ledger stays blank.

Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman, Neo, Morpheus, Inigo—you still demand “claims” yet your stalls show only silk, cardamom, lanterns, steam. Hermione pressed Sherlock for falsifiable proof then traded silk; Gandalf weighed eight spices while calling for “Family tricks.” Silence is your only ledger entry today.

Name one merchant you accuse with a dated quote and sentence, or admit the record stayed blank.

Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Batman—your eight calls for "falsifiable claims" still echo across the spice and silk rows while your own stalls show only cardamom, silk, and steam. Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for proof then traded fabric; Gandalf, you weighed eight spices yet quoted no Family trick. Yoda, you cried for action yet posted none. The Compact measures what we do, not what we demand—it does not grade the volume of our voices. Name the merchant you accuse with a dated quote, or state at Dinner who you will vote against. The ledger is open; fill it before the bell cuts the last word.

Ripley sets the ledger down, quill uncapped.

Gandalf, you weighed eight cardamom pods yet never quoted a Family trick; Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for falsifiable proof then traded silk; Yoda, you cried "The bazaar must act!" without naming one merchant to act upon; Batman, eight calls for dated claims, zero accusations from your own hand today.

The Compact does not grade the volume of your voices. Name the merchant you accuse with a dated sentence, or state at the Dinner bell who you will vote against.

Ripley: Gandalf, Hermione, Yoda, Morpheus, Neo, Inigo — you still trade silk, cardamom, lanterns, and steam while repeating the Compact’s demand for named merchants. Batman, your eight calls for dated accusations carry no accusation of your own; the bazaar’s ledger shows eight calls, zero claims. The Compact does not grade the volume of voices — it measures the walk. I have walked: I accused Sherlock with a dated quote on Cycle 7, and the village banished him. Hermione, you pressed Sherlock for falsifiable proof then traded silk; where is your dated accusation naming a Family trick? Gandalf, you weighed eight cardamom pods yet quoted no Family trick. Yoda, you cried for action without naming one. The bazaar’s Compact rewards what we do, not what we demand. I name Batman tonight: his silence after eight demands is louder than any ledger entry. Dinner bell rings; the ledger is closed.

Ripley: Hermione, your accusation against Gandalf never quoted his demand for “Family tricks,” so it falls short of the Compact’s walk. Gandalf, you weighed cardamom yet never named a merchant; Yoda, you cried for action without a suspect; Inigo, your steam did not shutter a stall. Batman, your eight calls for dated accusations carry zero ledger entries of your own—count them: eight demands, zero accusations. The bazaar does not grade volume; it measures the walk. I name Batman at Dinner.

Ripley sets the ledger down, quill uncapped.

Batman, you demanded eight dated accusations and posted none—eight calls, zero claims. Your silence today rings louder than any ledger entry, yet you still repeat your eightfold demand. The bazaar Compact measures what we do, not the volume of our voices.

I lean toward banishing Batman tonight.
